children: Volato completed key steps tied to its acquisition of Alignment Engine, finalizing an amended merger agreement that allocates 95% post-closing ownership to Aligned holders at a $500 million valuation. To support a stable transition and obtain required post-closing approvals, Volato executed 180-day lock-up agreements and voting support agreements with directors and officers. The company also advanced its financing plan by entering a waiver under its SPA and issuing a $7.5 million senior unsecured convertible note to JAK Opportunities, maturing in 2027.
Agreement 1: Volato Finalizes Aligned Merger Terms; Aligned Holders to Own 95% at $500M Valuation
: Amended and Restated Amendment to Agreement and Plan of Merger
: Clarify consideration and finalize ownership structure for the merger
Agreement 2: Volato Implements 180-Day Lock-Up for Directors and Officers Post-Aligned Merger
: Stabilize trading and align insiders during integration
Agreement 3: Volato Secures Voting Support From Key Holders for Post-Merger Approvals
: Ensure votes for stock issuance and governance changes
Agreement 4: Volato Obtains Waiver Under SPA From JAK Opportunities to Advance Financing Plan
: Waiver agreement under Securities Purchase Agreement
: Facilitate financing for Aligned growth plan
Agreement 5: Volato Issues $7.5 Million Senior Unsecured Convertible Note, Maturing in 2027
: Senior unsecured convertible promissory note (fifth tranche)
: Provide growth capital and support post-merger plan
